summary: Opens the MPEG audio decoder base. Handles a pending deferred-deactivation request, clears the bitstream buffer pointer, stores the sync word, validates the audio device via an arithmetic comparison and asserts with the file/line/function message if it fails, otherwise initializes decoder internals, computes network buffer timing, resets performance state, and computes frames-per-buffer plus total buffer size with a 64-bit division.
